findings.source_quote: βλέπω ἀπέναντί μου τὴν πρεσβυτέραν ἣν καὶ πέρυσιν ἑώρακειν
findings.english_quote: I saw the old woman whom I had also seen last year[h].
findings.issue: The simplified edition omits ἀπέναντί μου, which locates the woman opposite or in front of the narrator. Seeing her does not itself preserve this spatial detail.
findings.suggested_revision: Proposed for fresh review: “I saw before me the old woman whom I had also seen last year[h].”

summary: Both editions were reviewed independently against all four source paragraphs. The standard edition preserves the selected text; the simplified edition drops one spatial detail. Both retain the worthiness assertion, former sins, negations, copying explanation, return reply, and unidentified snatching agent. Their witness notes accurately reflect the supplied bounded reports, including correction layers, the Latin editorial emendation, and mediated Ethiopic evidence, without requiring replacement of the working readings. Acceptance is limited to this source-and-disclosure review, not authentication of unseen manuscripts or exhaustive collation.
